story_type: icebreaker frees a cruise ship trapped in Antarctic pack ice
hook: A cruise ship trapped in Antarctic ice. One icebreaker went in.
narration: A cruise ship was trapped in Antarctic pack ice, and this icebreaker was the one sent to break it out.
The Australian-owned Scenic Eclipse II ran into denser ice than expected, about eight nautical miles from McMurdo Station.
At around eleven at night, its crew called the Coast Guard Cutter Polar Star for help.
Polar Star is a three hundred ninety-nine foot heavy icebreaker that weighs thirteen thousand five hundred tons.
Its rounded bow rides up onto the ice, and the ship's own weight breaks it apart.
The cutter made two close passes to break up the ice around its hull.
The whole job took six hours, on the day Polar Star turned fifty years old.
outcome: Polar Star broke the cruise ship free and escorted it about four nautical miles to open water.
title: Cruise ship trapped in Antarctic ice
description:
On Jan. 17, 2026, the Coast Guard Cutter Polar Star freed the cruise ship Scenic Eclipse II from pack ice near McMurdo Station, Antarctica, on the icebreaker's 50th year of service, and escorted it to open water.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Christopher Bokum, U.S. Coast Guard Pacific Area, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/993381/uscgc-polar-star-wagb-10-provides-support-australian-owned-cruise-ship-stuck-ice-cutters-50th-birthday
